decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 08/12/2011, the proposal as shown on the drawing submitted on 22/11/2011 and numbered J.S/HN/9.9_3 and as verified on site was not lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The proposal is unlawful because the property is subject to the following permitted development restrictions:
There is a condition on the original consent for "the erection of a detached two storey house and domestic garage." Condition 2 of consent 00325/9/P10 states that:
"Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1977, or any subsequent legislation, no further extension or additions shall be constructed without the prior permission of the Local Planning Authority."
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of two side roof extensions and a rear roof extension and alterations to the roof of the rear projection of the house
